$description: EXAMPLE tenant theme — SS&C Technologies, included as ONE reference white-label theme (NOT the product base; decision B1). Demonstrates that adopting a brand is ~a dozen values. Source: the SS&C brand kit (design/SSCBranding). Emits the [data-theme="example-ssc"] scope in dist/tokens.css.

brand.$description: SS&C Blue #0077C8 as the 500/600 solid; deep blue #1F56A5 at 700 for AA small-text (kit flags #0077C8 on white ~4.0:1 — borderline for small body).
brand._accent_note: SS&C amber — use only as a CTA-hover or non-text accent; amber on white is NOT AA for text (kit rule). Secondary brand accent is SS&C purple #6f5091.

font.$description: Headings + buttons in Barlow Semi Condensed; body/UI in Inter. Both free Google Fonts — self-host for air-gap.

chart.$description: Left as inherit — an SS&C-brand chart palette (blue->teal->purple->green->amber from the kit's extended colors) MUST clear scripts/validate_palette.mjs before replacing the default. Until validated, inherit the accessibility-safe generic template.
